title: desert renewal
description: A mod that brings the desert to life.
body: Desert Renewal is a mod that adds new structures to the desert. The mod adds a tent, tower, oasis, temple, abandoned desert village, desert village, desert palace, and desert well. The Desert Mage will also appear. Why should you download this mod? If you feel like the desert in Minecraft feels empty, this mod will make the biome more interesting to explore.
